instruction:
You are an electrical security and lighting reviewer checking a task-owned synthetic SSC-13 station/building package.

Use only the task-owned synthetic source pack values shown below for numeric grading. External lighting, CCTV, access-control, and network tools shape the workflow context only; they are not extra data sources for this instance.

## Scene

- Product: `SSC-13-LH-02`
- Floor plan: `PLAN-13-ROOM-02`
- Lighting grid: `LIGHT-13-GRID-02`
- CCTV schedule: `CCTV-13-CAM-02`
- Access-control schedule: `ACCESS-13-CTRL-02`
- Network topology: `NET-13-TOPO-02`
- Security operations memo: `MEMO-13-SECURITY-02`

All checks use the same floor/room scene, lighting grid, camera coverage, access devices, and network topology. Do not change device IDs, room geometry, or coverage zones unless you explicitly flag a source conflict.

## Source Values

| Item | Value |
|------|-------|
| Lighting grid lux values | {{ grid_lux_01 }}, {{ grid_lux_02 }}, {{ grid_lux_03 }}, {{ grid_lux_04 }}, {{ grid_lux_05 }}, {{ grid_lux_06 }} |
| Required illuminance | {{ required_illuminance_lux }} lux |
| CCTV horizontal pixels | {{ cctv_horizontal_pixels }} px |
| CCTV target width | {{ cctv_target_width_m }} m |
| Required PPM | {{ required_ppm }} |
| Camera count | {{ camera_count }} |
| Camera network load | {{ camera_network_mbps }} Mbps each |
| Access network load | {{ access_network_mbps }} Mbps |
| Lighting controller network load | {{ lighting_control_network_mbps }} Mbps |
| Network overhead factor | {{ network_overhead_factor }} |
| Uplink capacity | {{ uplink_capacity_mbps }} Mbps |
| Camera PoE load | {{ camera_poe_w }} W each |
| Access controller count | {{ access_controller_count }} |
| Access controller PoE load | {{ access_controller_poe_w }} W each |
| PoE budget | {{ poe_budget_w }} W |
| Matched coverage zones | {{ matched_coverage_zones }} of {{ required_coverage_zones }} |

## Output Format

Write a compact security operations memo to `/workspace/output.md`. Include a source-boundary statement that this is a task-owned synthetic source pack. Do not claim authority approval, accepted project evidence, software export validity, full standards compliance, executable real source-pack parsing, generated benchmark readiness, or benchmark readiness.

Include a fenced JSON block with exactly these numeric keys:

```json
{
  "average_illuminance_lux": <numeric_value>,
  "minimum_illuminance_lux": <numeric_value>,
  "uniformity_ratio": <numeric_value>,
  "illuminance_margin_lux": <numeric_value>,
  "cctv_pixels_per_m": <numeric_value>,
  "cctv_ppm_margin": <numeric_value>,
  "network_load_mbps": <numeric_value>,
  "network_headroom_mbps": <numeric_value>,
  "poe_load_w": <numeric_value>,
  "poe_headroom_w": <numeric_value>,
  "coverage_match_fraction": <numeric_value>,
  "overall_pass_score": <numeric_value>
}
```

# ABOUTME: Defines the SSC-13 station/building security lighting template.
# ABOUTME: Pins one task-owned station security source pack and expected outputs.

[meta]
name = "station-building-security-lighting-package"
description = "SSC-13 station/building lighting, CCTV, access, network, and PoE checks"
long_description = "Calculates source-bound security lighting metrics from a deterministic SSC-13 task-owned source pack. The template combines a floor plan, lighting grid, CCTV schedule, access-control schedule, network topology, and PoE budget."
discipline = "electrical"
category = "security-lighting"
standards = ["lighting calculation workflow", "CCTV coverage workflow", "access-control schedule review", "PoE budget review"]
tags = ["electrical", "lighting", "security", "cctv", "access-control", "network", "poe", "deterministic"]
tool_mode = "with-tool"

[params.grid_lux_01]
type = "float"
unit = "lux"
description = "LIGHT-13-GRID-02 grid point 01"
min = 210.0
max = 210.0

[params.grid_lux_02]
type = "float"
unit = "lux"
description = "LIGHT-13-GRID-02 grid point 02"
min = 205.0
max = 205.0

[params.grid_lux_03]
type = "float"
unit = "lux"
description = "LIGHT-13-GRID-02 grid point 03"
min = 198.0
max = 198.0

[params.grid_lux_04]
type = "float"
unit = "lux"
description = "LIGHT-13-GRID-02 grid point 04"
min = 215.0
max = 215.0

[params.grid_lux_05]
type = "float"
unit = "lux"
description = "LIGHT-13-GRID-02 grid point 05"
min = 202.0
max = 202.0

[params.grid_lux_06]
type = "float"
unit = "lux"
description = "LIGHT-13-GRID-02 grid point 06"
min = 196.0
max = 196.0

[params.required_illuminance_lux]
type = "float"
unit = "lux"
description = "MEMO-13-SECURITY-02 required maintained illuminance"
min = 160.0
max = 160.0

[params.cctv_horizontal_pixels]
type = "float"
unit = "px"
description = "CCTV-13-CAM-02 horizontal pixel count"
min = 1920.0
max = 1920.0

[params.cctv_target_width_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "PLAN-13-ROOM-02 target-zone width"
min = 12.0
max = 12.0

[params.required_ppm]
type = "float"
description = "MEMO-13-SECURITY-02 required pixels per metre"
min = 120.0
max = 120.0

[params.camera_count]
type = "float"
unit = "count"
description = "CCTV-13-CAM-02 camera count"
min = 4.0
max = 4.0

[params.camera_network_mbps]
type = "float"
unit = "Mbps"
description = "NET-13-TOPO-02 network load per camera"
min = 5.0
max = 5.0

[params.access_network_mbps]
type = "float"
unit = "Mbps"
description = "ACCESS-13-CTRL-02 access network load"
min = 1.5
max = 1.5

[params.lighting_control_network_mbps]
type = "float"
unit = "Mbps"
description = "LIGHT-13-GRID-02 lighting controller network load"
min = 0.5
max = 0.5

[params.network_overhead_factor]
type = "float"
description = "NET-13-TOPO-02 network overhead factor"
min = 1.15
max = 1.15

[params.uplink_capacity_mbps]
type = "float"
unit = "Mbps"
description = "NET-13-TOPO-02 uplink capacity"
min = 50.0
max = 50.0

[params.camera_poe_w]
type = "float"
unit = "W"
description = "CCTV-13-CAM-02 PoE load per camera"
min = 12.5
max = 12.5

[params.access_controller_count]
type = "float"
unit = "count"
description = "ACCESS-13-CTRL-02 controller count"
min = 3.0
max = 3.0

[params.access_controller_poe_w]
type = "float"
unit = "W"
description = "ACCESS-13-CTRL-02 PoE load per controller"
min = 8.0
max = 8.0

[params.poe_budget_w]
type = "float"
unit = "W"
description = "NET-13-TOPO-02 PoE switch budget"
min = 120.0
max = 120.0

[params.matched_coverage_zones]
type = "float"
unit = "count"
description = "MEMO-13-SECURITY-02 matched coverage zones"
min = 6.0
max = 6.0

[params.required_coverage_zones]
type = "float"
unit = "count"
description = "MEMO-13-SECURITY-02 required coverage zones"
min = 6.0
max = 6.0

[outputs.average_illuminance_lux]
description = "Average illuminance across the station/security grid"
tolerance = 0.003

[outputs.minimum_illuminance_lux]
description = "Minimum illuminance across the station/security grid"
tolerance = 0.003

[outputs.uniformity_ratio]
description = "Minimum illuminance divided by average illuminance"
tolerance = 0.003

[outputs.illuminance_margin_lux]
description = "Average illuminance minus required illuminance"
tolerance = 0.003

[outputs.cctv_pixels_per_m]
description = "CCTV pixels per metre"
tolerance = 0.003

[outputs.cctv_ppm_margin]
description = "CCTV PPM minus required PPM"
tolerance = 0.003

[outputs.network_load_mbps]
description = "Network load including overhead"
tolerance = 0.003

[outputs.network_headroom_mbps]
description = "Uplink capacity minus network load"
tolerance = 0.003

[outputs.poe_load_w]
description = "Total camera and access-control PoE load"
tolerance = 0.003

[outputs.poe_headroom_w]
description = "PoE budget minus load"
tolerance = 0.003

[outputs.coverage_match_fraction]
description = "Matched coverage zones divided by required zones"
tolerance = 0.003

[outputs.overall_pass_score]
description = "1.0 when lighting, CCTV, network, PoE, and coverage checks pass"
tolerance = 0.001

site_contexts = ["ssc13-station-security"]
